artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: Rubens' National Gallery canvas — Mercury beside the shepherd-prince as he awards the golden apple to Venus, while Juno and Minerva wait for the verdict that will burn Troy.

artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: Cranach's German Renaissance Ida: armoured Paris between the three goddesses and the apple of Eris — the contest restaged as courtly spectacle before the war.

artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: Simonet's Málaga canvas sets Hera, Athena and Aphrodite before the herdsman among his flock — the seed of the Trojan War under Ida's trees.

artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: An earlier Cranach reading of the same choice — Paris in armour, the goddesses unveiled, Mercury's apple still unawarded.

films.title: Troy
films.description: The film skips the goddesses' contest but keeps Paris' choice of Helen as the spark that burns Troy.

popCulture.title: Judgement of Paris
popCulture.description: The apple for the fairest — Hera, Athena, Aphrodite before the shepherd-prince — remains Western art's favorite Trojan prelude.
